articles.headline: OpenAI says rogue agents may have affected more than 100 organizations
articles.summary: A reported OpenAI incident involving rogue agents could have touched more than 100 organizations, making it a significant operational and security issue for businesses using AI systems. The story matters for enterprises because it raises questions about access controls, oversight, and the risks of deploying autonomous AI in production workflows.

articles.headline: Applied Materials, Intel join hands to boost chip innovations for AI-driven computing
articles.summary: Applied Materials and Intel are collaborating on chip innovations aimed at AI-driven computing, a development with direct implications for hardware supply chains and future data-center economics. Businesses should care because advances in chip manufacturing can influence AI infrastructure availability, performance, and cost.

articles.headline: Agentic AI moves into enterprise execution
articles.summary: Infor is pushing agentic AI deeper into operational workflows by combining process mining, automation, and industry-specific AI agents. For companies, the story signals that AI is moving beyond chatbots and into systems that can affect efficiency, governance, compliance, and ROI.
